item.title: Large swells bring ideal surf conditions to San Diego coastline
item.description: San Diego is experiencing a high surf advisory with waves reaching up to 10 feet, and a high rip current risk warning, making it ideal for experienced surfers but dangerous for inexperienced swimmers.

item.title: Spring Valley search warrant yields guns and stolen property, including Home Depot truck
item.description: A 34-year-old man in Spring Valley, California was arrested on suspicion of drug, weapon, and fraud charges after a high-risk search warrant of his home yielded firearms, narcotics, stolen property, and a fraud lab.

item.title: Did Tony Hawk get married on Epstein's island?
item.description: Tony Hawk has denied rumors that he was married on Jeffrey Epstein's private island, providing a detailed timeline of his four weddings and emphasizing that none took place on Epstein's island.

item.title: Brad Arnold, lead singer of Grammy-nominated rock band 3 Doors Down, dies at 47
item.description: LOS ANGELES (AP) — Brad Arnold, the lead singer of the Grammy-nominated rock band 3 Doors Down, died Saturday, months after he announced that he had been diagnosed with Stage 4 kidney cancer. item.description: "We beg you now to return our mother to us so that we can celebrate with her."

item.title: Plane makes emergency landing on SR-67 in Lakeside
item.description: A single engine private plane made an emergency landing on State Route 67 in Lakeside on Saturday morning, partially blocking the slow lane with its wing.

item.title: Seahawks, Patriots rivalry takes over Pacific Beach bars ahead of Super Bowl rematch
item.description: Two San Diego bars, Thrusters and The Sandbox, are preparing for a Super Bowl rematch between the Seattle Seahawks and the New England Patriots, with both expecting large crowds and extra seating to accommodate fans.

item.title: Balboa Park protest calls for complete repeal of parking fee policy
item.description: Opponents of new parking fees at Balboa Park held a protest over the weekend, criticizing city leaders for the policy which they argue is hurting museums, restaurants, and visitors while failing to address the city's budget problems.

item.title: Two of San Diego's finest starting for Seahawks in Super Bowl LX
item.description: San Diego natives Rashid Shaheed and Jason Myers will be taking the field for the Seattle Seahawks in Super Bowl LX against the New England Patriots, both having started their football journeys in SoCal.

item.title: Cliff jumpers rescued after getting stuck in high surf at Sunset Cliffs
item.description: Four people were rescued from Sunset Cliffs in Ocean Beach after becoming stuck while recreationally leaping off the cliff, with one person taken to a local hospital with non-life-threatening injuries.
